hook: B (단정형): Your SPF moisturizer misses more skin than sunscreen.
caption:
does SPF moisturizer protect as well as sunscreen?

Your SPF moisturizer misses more skin than sunscreen — and you probably won’t notice.

In a UV camera study, 84 people applied an SPF 30 sunscreen and an SPF 30 moisturizer on separate visits. With the moisturizer, they missed more of the face: 16.6% compared with 11.1% for sunscreen. Most of the difference was around the eyes (20.9% vs 14.0% of the eyelid area missed). Afterwards, people didn't realise they had missed anything.

Check yours: next time you use it, look in a mirror. Did it reach your eyelids?

On a sunny day, a moisturizer with SPF is a good start, not the whole plan.
